tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus mdos kyi tshogs dbu la zhal ngo thugs brel gyi dbang gis phebs ma thub dus gang zag gzhan gyi chog dpon byed skabs kyi phyag len gyi rnam dbye gsal bar ston pa'i tho yig bzhugs// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ yig chung bsring don/ bsod dbang dpon slob rnams dang / byams pa dpal 'byor/ dpon slob brgya dpon pa/ spyi chen/ ban tshang ba'i las tshan so so/ /zor las pa/ dbyangs dpon la sogs pa mdos chen pa kun gyis nges dgos/ sngar sor bsrings nang ltar/ nged rang der yod skabs yin na/ da lo'i ba go 'di yangs po yang yod 'dug pas mi ngo ma thar ba kun gyis thar na de rang legs pa 'dug kyang / nged phyogs su bsdad skabs der su la byung yang / gzhis byes kun blo mdzad cing bstan pa'i rgyun 'di dar rgyas yong ba yang gegs chen po zhig ka 'dug pas/ slar 'gyod bcas kyi rgyur song dogs pas/ sngar sor mo rtags sdug pas kyang bsod dbang tshogs dbang bskur 'gro ba de cig tsam ma gtogs thams cad mthun par ma chug byung bas/ rim gro 'phar ma de bzhin byas pa yin zhing / da cha zla ba gnyis pa'i 'jug las dus mdos 'gyang thabs mi 'dug pas/ slar yang bsod dbang tshogs dbang bskur phyin na nyes skyon yod med kyi mo rtags dang ni chen bsdur bas bzang chug rang zhig ma byung bas/ des na sngon sngags 'chang chen po dbus phyogs bzhugs rgyun ring ba zhig la mkhan chen dpal bzang po dang / yab rje bde gshegs de nyid thog mar sku yun ring bsnyel tshul bstan/ de nas gdeng mgo bstan kyang karma zhwa dmar ba rten mjal sogs la byon pa'i rkyen gyis rigs 'dzin pho brang du sku mtshams ma bsang par bzhugs/ bla ma mgon bkras pas chog dpon byas 'dug pa bzhin/ da lam yang nged rang zhal ngo mi 'byon rtsis kyis khyed dus mdos pa dpon slob rnams kyi phyag bzhes mdzad dgos/ nyer gnyis la spyi mchod pas spyan gzigs 'grems pa/

gtor bzo sogs dang / mchod g.yog sogs ban tshang ba'i gtor bzo ba rnams kyis mgon khang chen po'i dam rdzas bskang gtor rgyas pa/ tshoms chen gyi bskang gtor 'cho ba sogs sngar rgyun ltar dang / nyer gsum gyi snga bar bzhi thog tu bca' sgrigs kyi rol mo bcas sam nas 'cham sku spyan 'dren nas bzung / nyer dgu'i mdos rgya ma grub bar gyi cho ga phyag len mdzad dgos thams cad sngags 'chang chen po'i deb sgrig dang / nged rang gi dus phyis zhag grangs spar ba'i cho ga'i tho yig nang bzhin 'chug med ngos/ tshoms chen gyi bzhugs khri chen mo nub kyi skya rtsar spos pa'i mdun du brgya dpon pa la gsum gdan snyel 'bol mtho ba cog rtse dang bcas pa'i mdun du gdong gral gnyis sngar rgyun bzhin gyi dbu mdzad rnams rdzogs 'tshams g.yas su bsam bstan rin chen/ g.yon du byams pa sangs rgyas/ de nas g.yas g.yon gdong dga' dang lung phu dbu mdzad dung mkhan sogs sngar bzhin dang / dbyangs dpon kun rnam khrod la gsar pa rdo rje rin chen/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan khrod la gsar pa dge 'dun grags pa/ rol mo brgya dpon par bkra shis 'brug sgra/ rol dpon dbu mdzad ngag dbang rgyal mtshan la stong gsum 'brug sgra/ bsam bstan rin chen la pu tra lha dga'/ dbu byed chos rin chen la pu tra ma 'bring po/ byams pa sangs rgyas la hor sdug dpa' spong ma/ gdong dga' dang lu phu dbu byed gnyis la nyi 'brug dang gser khang ma chen mo/ kun grags par sbug chol chen mo/ de'i zla'u rin chen grags pa dang byams pa rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan la pu tra ma chen mo/ yang dbyangs res tshugs nas rnga byas te chos 'phel gyis dkrol/ byams pa rdo rjer grangs chen sil snyan/ gnyer khang nas las chen klub pa 'phral du bso pa'i gdan bzhugs khri chen mo'i g.yas dang / rol mo zhing skyong ma/ zor las pa rnams bzhugs khri'i g.yon la bcar nas byang du sa stong bzhog

kun dga' rnam dpyod gral gung gral du sngar rgyun bzhin la/ 'chams sku spyan 'dren/ mdos rgyag tshoms chen rnams su rkang dung 'bud pa dang / 'jam dang ja rnams kyi gsus brda spyi mchod pa rgyud pa'i sngar bzhin byed/ mdos rgyag nyin sngar gyi rkang dung 'bud grogs yang dgon pas pa'i/ tshe bkras btsun chung rnga pa byed/ mdos rgyag nyin rnga rol pa rnams 'gyogs bul byung na kun rnams kyis sgrigs/ de nyin brgya dpon pa la rnga pa'i dbus su grum ze byas pa'i rol mo sngan rgyun bzhin las rnga sogs mi byed/ brgya dpon nas brtsam rnga pa rnams la gos bem dang / rol mo ba rnams la phod ka sogs zhal ngo ma phebs pas mi dgos pas/ so so nas zab spros gang drag dang / brgya dpon pa yang rnga pa rnams dang mnyam du phyin nas/ 'cham sku'i rjes la mi bsdod/ de bzhin du rol dpon gyis kyang 'cham sku thams cad zam pa thon nas bya khra mar phebs byung ba dang rol mo bsgyur bar byed/ khrims pa rnams kyis 'cham sku'i mtha' bskor te mi bsrung ba gal che zhing / cho ga 'tshog dus chog dpon la spos sna/ skya ho sogs kyis skyes bsu/ phebs rol sogs mi dgos pa mnyam du 'tshogs pas chog cho ga'i sgrigs rims gnas yo byin rlabs/ spyan ras gzigs bskyed chog ma ṇi nyer gcig lhag tsam/ de'i chu sbyin/ tog gcig ma/ mi 'khrugs pa dang ye shes skar mda'i chu sbyin/ 'dzam sor nag gi bskyed chog gtor 'bul/ chu sbyin/ 'og gi tshogs byin rlabs/ zhal zas/ ma da na/ tshogs phud 'bul ba sogs tshogs la gtor skad gtong ba dang dpon slob rnams kyis ngag 'don gang 'grig mdzad pa/ so sor mtshams chod cing nyag nyog tu ma song ba mdzad dgos shing / dkar cha bzhi/ mgo'i sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gong gi des chog pas skabs 'dir mi mdzad pa dang / chu sbyin yang gong du song bas gzhi bdag gtor ma grub 'phral/ na mo bdag gi bsam pa'i sogs man chad mdzad pa deb sgrig bzhin dang /

'og gi tshogs phud 'bul skabs kyai rdor gtor sngags nas/ phur bsrung gi bar yongs rdzogs tshang 'brig dgos rgyu dang / cho ga'i bskul lugs sngon sngags 'chang chen po dang khri chen bde gshegs phebs skabs/ da lta nged rang gi byed pa bzhin bstod pa'i skabs rnams ma gtogs/ thams cad gong nas gnang ba zhig yod 'dug cing / yab rje bde gshegs kyi phyag len la gnas yo byin rlabs/ gtor skad gtong ba'i mgo so so/ /lam dus kyi bzlas grangs dang mtshams so so/ /mdun bskyed/ gtor ma byin rlabs sogs dang / 'og gi tshogs byin rlabs nas/ mjug chog gi bar bkra shis dang bcas pa gong nas bskul bar mdzad cing / bshags pa'i oṃ badzra sa mā dza nas/ bskang bzlog gtso dbyangs snga ma'i bar rnams/ sngon dbu mdzad so so dang / dus phyis sgar chen/ sku 'bring / nged rang gis kyang bskul ba'i phyag phyi byas shing / da lam chog dpon gyis byed dgos zhu/ 'bul phyag rnams grub pa dang / slob dpon rang gi maṇḍal sngon 'gro'i rim gnyis kyi thugs dam la bskul ba dang / bdun bskyed kyi mchod pa byin rlabs dang / mdun bskyed bsgrub pa bskul ba gnyis/ mjug gi bsngo ba rnams nges par bya dgos shing / gzhan ma bzlas grangs so so'i tshad dang bskul dgos rnams/ dbu byed bskul res su yin gyi byas chog pas/ gang ltar khyed rang dpon slob rnams gros mthun steng nas byed lugs dang bsngo ba'i skabs nged rang zhal ngo 'gro na/ bla brang nang nas bsgrub pa la bdag sogs sems can thams cad la dgongs gsol dang / gdan sa mdzod chen sogs la/ sbyin pa'i bdag po la dgongs gsol byed pa yin kyang / da lam gnyis ka la che brjod skabs su babs pa re byas na legs par mngon/ thugs dam nyi ma snga ma rnams kyi 'gros dang bstun/ zor las pa rnams kyis lho dang nub/ byang rnams su bskul dang bcas gtor ma 'phang ba dang / ban tshang pa gzhon pa re mos kyis rkang dung 'bud par 'gro ba sogs sngar rgyun bzhin dang /

dgu'i snga dro cha ོ ga 'grub 'phral/ brgya dpon pas/ mdos gtor rnams spyi mchod pas zla'u dang bcas gtor kha shar la bsgyur bar byed cing / lam dus tshugs nas ma grub bar tshogs dpon gyi dbu zhwa bzhes pa nged rang zhal ngo rnams kyi phyag len la yod kyang / da lam ma gyon pas chog shar nub kyi gtor 'bul zab rgyas sogs sngar bzhin la/ rol mo phar spod tshur spod mi byed pa'i rtsis dang / cho ga rnams grol nas ban tshang ba dung mkhan dang bcas pa gser khang du ja thog 'tshogs nas dbyangs chags tho nang bzhin byed pa sngar bzhin dang / dung gi snga phyi/ tshogs skad gtong lugs ni nyin bzhin byed/ mdos rgyag grub nas dmag chang bzhugs gral tshoms chen du byas pa'i brgya dpon pa sngar gyi gdan steng dang / ban tshang pa rnams gung gral gnyis/ spyi chen dang dung mkhan bla ma'i g.yas/ gtor las pa rnams g.yon gyi gong gral la bsgrig 'di dang nyer brgyad kyi bdud rtsi lnga mchod skabs/ mus kyi gnyer pa lha rje/ dbu byed chos 'od/ khams pa sogs sngar bzhugs gral la sgrig pa rnams/ da lo phyir skal ba sprad nas nang du sgrig mi dgos/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod skabs tshogs dpon gyis ḍa dril ma byas kyang chog cing / byed na zhal ngos drug cu pa'i skabs mdzad pa bzhin byed cing / cang te'u 'don mi dgos/ dmag chang steng brgya dpon pas gdung rabs sogs la bshad pa gang 'os byed/ da lo mgon khang chen mo'i 'cham sku bzhi po mi 'byon rtsis dang / gzhan ma las mkhan 'cham mkhan rnams sngar rgyun bzhin 'grig yod pas de rnams dang / 'cham sku rnams 'cham khang nas 'byon pa/ g.yag gzeng 'phral du 'byon pa sogs kyis rting bskul/ phebs skyel sogs spyi chen gyis rus su thon pa byed/ bstod pa tshugs nas chog dpon zor las pa dang bcas pas mkhon spyugs sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas yi ge brgya pa brgya lhag tsam dang / de nas tshogs dpon dang mgon po'i gtor las pas yi ge bdun ma gtso bo dang /

gzhan gtor las pa so sos rang rang gi sngags rnams gtso bo dang / gzhan rnams kyang phreng skor re tsam tshang 'grig re bzla ba/ yig brgya nas phur bsrung gi sngags kyi bar gtor bsngod kyi bzlas pa'i skabs sgra ji bzhin/ dmigs pa rje rdo rje 'chang gi man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal gyi drag po'i skabs de byed cing / tshogs chen gyi 'ur rgyag ngos/ dkar mo ba'i bstod dbyangs tshugs su nye ba dang / chog dpon dang zor las pa rnams mig lta sgrigs nas spyir mahā kā la sogs sngags gsum la dril bu chig brdung dang / de nas dril bu bcad btab dang bcas sangs rgyas bstan bsrung ma'i las mkhan gyi bstod pa bsdus pa grub pa yan dril sil dang bcas byed cing dkar mo ba man tshogs pa byin dang bstun nas byed/ mgon khang rnams kyi bskang gso ba gzhan rnams 'grig yod cing / sgo rum du chog dpon sngar las yod pas rab 'byams pa bsod nams bzang po mtshams 'thon nas byed lugs dang / ja thug len mi sku gnyer rang gi 'os zhig rnyed dam/ de min lha khang na yod pa'i tsha'o de byed du bcug pas yong 'dug cing / cho ga'i zhabs tog thams cad sngar bzhin la/ 'phar ja yang rgyun du dang / chog dpon la shar pa dang mkhan chen 'byon na 'di bzhin byed deb chen na yod pas de bzhin dang / gzhan ma nyer brgyad kyi mtshams res/ nyer dgu'i rgyab dmag sogs sngar bzhin 'chug med yong ba gong bkod rnams kyi do dam gnyer khang nas rnga len rus su thon pa dang / mdos chen pa dpon slob rnams kyis bla ma gong ma'i zhabs tog bsam pa'i so so nas thugs khur bzhes pa'i thugs khur 'dzol med yong ba cis kyang gal che/ gong du cung zad ma thus pa tshogs su rnga dbu byed gnyis la nag rnga chen mo gnyis/ byin la yab rje bde gshegs kyi gser rnga che chung dang / byang pa'i gser rnga rnams sngar lugs bzhin byed/ mol la ba mang 'tshams bstod pa'i dbyangs res ring thung la dpags nas dbyangs res bzhi lnga ma rdzogs tsam la lang pas snga phyi ran par yong /

nyer brgyad dang dgu'i snga dro'i thor dung sngar lugs bzhin/ skya ho rnams tshogs su 'tshogs nas chog dpon gyi dkar yol ma phul bar sa la mi bsdod pa dang / mol la ba lang nas de dang bstun nas sdod pa sogs sngar gyi sgrigs yin pas byed dgos/ dbyangs chags skabs drug cu pa'i las tshan rnams la lto chang ster ba yang sngar bzhin/ 'cham res kyi nyin gnyer khang pa gcig don chen/ gsang yum ma chen sogs nang zan 'os 'gab gang rigs la rtsi ma dang bcas khroms zil gnon pa rnams gtong ba sngar bzhin dang / mdos rgyag gi nyin bzhi thog tu dung rgya gling gtong ba grub 'phral/ tshogs cher mor tshogs dung btang pa'i byung 'phral dpon slob rnams tshogs rang du ma gtogs/ bzhi thog nas rgya gling dang bcas 'byon pa de mi byed/ tshogs chen mo'i rnga pa rnams dang rol mo ba'i gral sgrig lugs ni nyin bzhin dang / mdos rgyag nyin dang gtor 'bul skabs dbu byed rnga pa gsum la gzim chung gi dpal rab ma dang mu khra ma gnyis byed/ 'chams sku spyan 'dren dang mdos rgyag gi nyin 'chams sku byon pa yin pas rol mo rnams kyi bar dang / bya khra ma'i gsol ja mchod rin rgya gling 'bud/ bstod pa'i bar la gtor las pa so sos bzlas pa byed lugs zhal gyi des zhal bzhi pa'i sngags ring thung gang rigs/ pu tra'i des las mkhan gyi bod sbad bsad gsum/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ba des sha sa na gtso bo dang / lha mo'i sngags ring thung gang rigs/ bdud rgyal gyi des dkar bdud kyi sngags gnyis gtso bor bzla ba yin zhes sngags chen po'i gsung rgyun 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi gsungs las thos pa lags pas kun gyi thugs la 'dzin pa zhu/ zhes pa 'di yang rang gi rjes 'jug don gnyer can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ sa skya pa chos med a nandas mgyogs par bris pa 'dis bla ma gong ma dang bstan bsrung rnams dges nas 'di dang phyi mi'i bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig
